import NCD_KMX_CopyMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NCD_FillFrame
/-- Full allocation carrier, including its initialized length and unchanged
address/capacity. Native validity and ownership are separate obligations. -/
structure Carrier (α : Type) where
  storage : Nat → α
  address : Nat
  capacity : Nat
  length : Nat

def step {α : Type} (s : Carrier α) (value : α) : Carrier α :=
  { s with storage := KMX_CopyMeaning.write s.storage (s.address+s.length) value,
           length := s.length+1 }

/-- Local native write observations on the SAME allocation; no whole output
or successful resize/model execution is assumed. -/
inductive Trace {α : Type} (value : α) : Carrier α → Nat → Carrier α → Prop
  | zero (s) : Trace value s 0 s
  | next {s middle final count} : Trace value s count middle →
      middle.length < middle.capacity → final = step middle value →
      Trace value s (count+1) final

theorem metadata {α : Type} {value : α} {s out : Carrier α} {n : Nat}
    (trace : Trace value s n out) :
    out.address=s.address ∧ out.capacity=s.capacity ∧ out.length=s.length+n := by
  induction trace with
  | zero => exact ⟨rfl,rfl,by omega⟩
  | @next middle final count trace spare same ih =>
    subst final
    simp only [step]
    exact ⟨ih.1,ih.2.1,by omega⟩

/-- Compose selected native windows over the full unchanged carrier using
KMX's already proved indexed-write law. -/
theorem storage {α : Type} {value : α} {s out : Carrier α} {n : Nat}
    (trace : Trace value s n out) (k : Nat) :
    out.storage k =
      if s.address+s.length ≤ k ∧ k < s.address+s.length+n then value else s.storage k := by
  induction trace with
  | zero =>
    have h : ¬(s.address+s.length ≤ k ∧ k < s.address+s.length+0) := by omega
    simp only [if_neg h]
  | @next middle final count trace spare same ih =>
    have fields :=  metadata trace
    subst final
    change KMX_CopyMeaning.write middle.storage (middle.address+middle.length) value k = _
    simp only [KMX_CopyMeaning.write,fields.1,fields.2.2]
    by_cases hit : k=s.address+(s.length+count)
    · have yes : s.address+s.length ≤ k ∧ k < s.address+s.length+(count+1) := by omega
      simp only [if_pos hit,if_pos yes]
    · rw [if_neg hit,ih]
      have eq : (s.address+s.length ≤ k ∧ k < s.address+s.length+count) ↔
          (s.address+s.length ≤ k ∧ k < s.address+s.length+(count+1)) := by omega
      simp only [eq]

theorem initialized14759 {α : Type} {value : α} {s out : Carrier α}
    (empty : s.length=0) (capacity : s.capacity=14759)
    (trace : Trace value s 14759 out) :
    out.address=s.address ∧ out.capacity=14759 ∧ out.length=14759 ∧
    (∀ k, out.storage k=if s.address≤k ∧ k<s.address+14759 then value else s.storage k) := by
  have fields :=  metadata trace
  refine ⟨fields.1,fields.2.1.trans capacity,by omega,?_⟩
  intro k
  simpa only [empty,Nat.add_zero] using storage trace k

#print axioms metadata
#print axioms storage
#print axioms initialized14759
end NCD_FillFrame

import NCD_R_NCB_DotNativeStep
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NCD_DotCutTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
/-- Ordered scalar/coefficient/eight-cell observations from the SAME range
and arrays. Existence of these native observations remains a native gate. -/
inductive Cuts (q : Array U8 608#usize) (g : Array FIo_Install.NE 29#usize)
    (slot : Usize) : Nat → core.ops.range.Range Usize →
    Array U64 8#usize → Array U64 8#usize → Prop
  | done (n iter sums) (stop : iter.end.val ≤ iter.start.val) :
      Cuts q g slot n iter sums sums
  | step (n iter next before after final wide coefficient scalar)
      (active : iter.start.val < iter.end.val) (small : n<4)
      (increment : next.start.val=iter.start.val+1) (ending : next.end=iter.end)
      (scalarRead : JFr_TX2_ScalarRead.read q slot iter.start=ok scalar)
      (wideRead : Array.index_usize g iter.start=ok wide)
      (limbRead : FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_limbs wide=ok coefficient)
      (canonical : JFs_TX2_ArrayEight.Canon coefficient) (scalarDomain : scalar.val<2147483647)
      (cells : NBS_NativeEight.Observed coefficient scalar before after)
      (tail : Cuts q g slot (n+1) next after final) :
      Cuts q g slot n iter before final

theorem bound (coefficient : Array U32 8#usize) (scalar : U32)
    (before after : Array U64 8#usize) (n : Nat)
    (hc : JFs_TX2_ArrayEight.Canon coefficient) (hscalar : scalar.val<2147483647)
    (hn : n<4) (hs : JFs_TX2_ArrayEight.Bound before n)
    (cells : NBS_NativeEight.Observed coefficient scalar before after) :
    JFs_TX2_ArrayEight.Bound after (n+1) := by
  obtain ⟨out,run,bounded⟩ := JFs_TX2_ArrayEight.source coefficient scalar before n hc hscalar hn hs
  have observed := NBS_NativeEight.source coefficient scalar before after n hc hscalar hn hs cells
  have same := Result.ok.inj (run.symm.trans observed)
  simpa only [same] using bounded

theorem associated (q : Array U8 608#usize) (g : Array FIo_Install.NE 29#usize)
    (slot : Usize) (n : Nat) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (before final : Array U64 8#usize)
    (cuts : Cuts q g slot n iter before final) (hs : JFs_TX2_ArrayEight.Bound before n) :
    FIp_NativeDots.fast_dots.four_dots_one_loop0_loop0 iter q g slot before=ok final := by
  induction cuts with
  | done n iter sums stop =>
    have terminal : FIp_NativeDots.fast_dots.four_dots_one_loop0_loop0.body q g slot iter sums=
        ok (done sums) := by
      obtain ⟨⟨o,next⟩,run,none,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
        (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_none_spec
          (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
          (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro a b;rfl) iter stop)
      subst o
      rw [JFr_TX2_DotStep.body]
      simp only [JFr_TX2_DotStep.step,run,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
    unfold FIp_NativeDots.fast_dots.four_dots_one_loop0_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,terminal]
  | step n iter next before after final wide coefficient scalar active small increment ending scalarRead wideRead limbRead canonical scalarDomain cells tail ih =>
    have nextBound := bound coefficient scalar before after n canonical scalarDomain small hs cells
    have tailRun := ih nextBound
    obtain ⟨cursor,inc,he,body⟩ := NCB_DotNativeStep.source q g slot iter before after wide
      coefficient scalar n active scalarRead wideRead limbRead canonical scalarDomain small hs cells
    have same : cursor=next := by
      cases cursor with
      | mk a b =>
        cases next with
        | mk c d =>
          dsimp only at inc he increment ending
          have ac : a=c := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (inc.trans increment.symm)
          have bd : b=d := he.trans ending.symm
          cases ac
          cases bd
          rfl
    rw [same] at body
    unfold FIp_NativeDots.fast_dots.four_dots_one_loop0_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,body]
    exact tailRun
#print axioms bound
#print axioms associated
end NCD_DotCutTrace
end

import NCD_FillFrame
import NCD_B_NCB_Filled14759
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NCD_FillAssociation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent AspisR1.NP6_StdModel
/-- Read the initialized prefix of the SAME full carrier. The exterior frame
and allocation metadata remain available from NCD_FillFrame; no owned vector
or native trace existence follows from the readback relation alone. -/
theorem contents {α : Type} {value : α} {s out : NCD_FillFrame.Carrier α} {n : Nat}
    (empty : s.length=0) (trace : NCD_FillFrame.Trace value s n out)
    (cells : List α) (length : cells.length=n)
    (readback : ∀ i (bound : i<cells.length), cells[i]=out.storage (s.address+i)) :
    cells=List.replicate n value := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_replicate,length]
  · intro i hi hj
    have inside : s.address+s.length≤s.address+i ∧ s.address+i<s.address+s.length+n := by omega
    have initialized := NCD_FillFrame.storage trace (s.address+i)
    rw [if_pos inside] at initialized
    rw [readback i hi,initialized]
    simp

/-- Associate that native readback with the inherited exact preparation-size
model result; no new initialization theorem or allocation success is assumed. -/
theorem model14759 {T : Type} (copy : core.marker.Copy T) (value : T)
    (cloned : copy.cloneInst.clone value=ok value)
    (s out : NCD_FillFrame.Carrier T) (empty : s.length=0)
    (trace : NCD_FillFrame.Trace value s 14759 out) (cells : List T)
    (length : cells.length=14759)
    (readback : ∀ i (bound : i<cells.length), cells[i]=out.storage (s.address+i)) :
    ∃ model : alloc.vec.Vec T,
      aspis_core.r0.heap.filled (ClaimsUnrolledFinish.external (calls (.Ok ())))
        copy 14759#usize value=ok (.Ok model) ∧ model.val=cells := by
  have same := contents empty trace cells length readback
  refine ⟨⟨List.replicate 14759 value,by simp only [List.length_replicate];scalar_tac⟩,
    NCB_Filled14759.model copy value cloned,same.symm⟩
#print axioms contents
#print axioms model14759
end NCD_FillAssociation
